question: The supreme court has published new guidelines for which designation on 17 July 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Senior Advocate**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On 17 July 2023, the Supreme Court published new guidelines specifically for the designation of **Senior Advocate**.
 
• Senior Advocates are a distinct class of advocates recognized for their expertise, experience, and contributions to the legal field.
 
• The guidelines aim to streamline the process and criteria for the designation, ensuring that only the most qualified legal professionals are honored with this title.
 
• These changes are part of the judiciary's ongoing efforts to maintain high standards of legal practice and uphold the integrity of the legal profession.
 
• The designation of Senior Advocate is considered a mark of distinction and is granted based on merit and competence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Supreme Court of India is the highest judicial forum and final court of appeal under the Constitution of India.
 
• It was established on 28 January 1950, two days after India's Constitution came into effect.
 
• The Supreme Court consists of the Chief Justice of India and a maximum of 33 other judges, appointed by the President of India.
 
• The court has extensive powers in terms of judicial review and can strike down laws that violate the Constitution.
 
• The institution plays a critical role in the interpretation and protection of the Constitution, ensuring justice, equality, and liberty for all citizens.
 
• The process and criteria for designating Senior Advocates are periodically reviewed to adapt to the changing dynamics of the legal profession.
